post.description: Endpoint to add or update content that will be available for search. Any data passed to this endpoint will be either added (if the url doesn't already exist), updated (if the url is already present). A maximum of 1000 records per batch is allowed, with a total maximum of 25000 records by default (configurable per community). Maximum size of the payload per request is 5M. The source value will be set to 'federated' when not specified.

requestBody.description: Json with batch of records to index

post.summary: Delete federated search content for specified source
post.description: Endpoint to delete federated search content for specified source. The 'source' parameter is required and indicates which external system's content to remove. Valid values include: 'federated', 'zendesk', 'intercom', 'freshdesk', or a custom source identifier provided when the content was originally added.

requestBody.description: Json with the source type to delete

post.summary: Delete specific urls from federated search
post.description: Endpoint to delete specific items from federated search. Accepts a list of urls that identify content to remove.

requestBody.description: Json with list of urls to delete
